title: ZIA security baseline, AI Guard routing and detection policy, AI Guard readiness

checks.what: every tier x mode x overlay set (4 x 3 x 11): names <= 31 and unique, locked rules on and Allow, DNS redirect locked, sources cited, overlays never change a rule
oracle table of tier defaults per rule; ATP defaults per tier and every switch off flagged
every tier x mode applies DISABLED, catch-alls last, re-run is a no-op (fakes and the offline sample through the SDK classes)
framework files as untrusted input: format, version, areas, sizes, names, every field type
Undo specs as untrusted input for the baseline and both AI Guard builders
typed phrase for live changes (rules created or enabled, ATP, certificate moves, AI Guard writes)
re-read before each write; changed, renamed, created or deleted since the preview is a conflict
proxy chain order: certificate, proxy, destination group, QUIC block, SSL Inspect, forwarding rule
SSL Inspect kept above every enabled Do Not Decrypt rule; Allow above Block, Caution or Isolate only when needed
detection policy per profile x mode oracle; Monitor default; entity lists valid and disjoint
readiness reads only, no secrets, fails closed on unreadable lists
AI Guard forwarder host allow-list (look-alikes, newline, long input)
the baseline and AI Guard page scripts escape every tenant and file string (E())
certificate lists keep id, name, type, status and dates only; readiness carries no key or PEM
a framework rule whose name equals a customer rule updates that rule in place (by design, shown field by field in the preview)

VERIFIED against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3: URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection (TLS acronyms via helpers.to_lower_camel_case), Sandbox, DNS Control (REDIR_REQ_KEEP_SENDER), File Type Control, Cloud App Control fields and add_rule(rule_type); the 20 ATP switches (fileFormatVunerabilitesBlocked spelling); readers list_ready_to_use, list_isolation_profiles, dns_gatways.list_dns_gateways (natZtrGateway), list_categories_lite, list_network_apps, list_cloud_app_policy; proxies, proxy gateways (read only), IP destination groups (DSTN_DOMAIN), list_network_services, forwarding_control, url_categories lookup/add, URL and app settings, get_subscriptions; AI Guard policies, policy-match-rules and llm-providers at /aiguard/v1 with the policy and rule fields

ASSUMED (not in the SDK model or enum lists): Sandbox cbiProfile (commented out in the 1.11.3 model, sent as given), firewall BLOCK_DROP and BLOCK_ICMP, sandbox first-time operations other than ALLOW_SCAN, File Type Control UPLOAD_DOWNLOAD, matchCriteria.llmProviders, enableClaudePrompt / enableGrokPrompt / enableMistralAIPrompt, the root certificate path, detector and PII entity names

findings.title: A framework or captured rule that names nothing to match was created as a match-all rule
findings.fix: fit() drops any non-catch-all rule with no match field (MATCH_FIELDS per area), with the reason

findings.title: AI Guard routing and detection policy applied live (enabled) changes without the typed phrase when 10 or fewer
findings.fix: both builders set confirm_always (APPLY n CHANGES) for every plan with a change, Undo included

findings.title: A Sandbox rule re-read through the SDK 1.11.3 model lost its isolation profile: updates stripped it, read-back was a false mismatch
findings.fix: get_one merges every field the model leaves out from the raw answer, as list reads do

findings.title: Other Bulk changes operations re-read rules with admin_ops._one, which drops fields the SDK model lacks (sandbox cbiProfile) before a PUT
findings.fix: Already fixed on integrate/w6: admin_ops._one now returns pack_export.one_row(ret), which backfills the raw answer's fields the SDK model drops (sandbox cbiProfile); no change needed

findings.title: Framework fields of the wrong shape raised AttributeError, a string list field was split into letters, values with a trailing newline, a non-boolean switch, any min_tls and format_version true were accepted
findings.fix: load_framework checks fields per type (list, name, boolean, TLS version) with fullmatch; format_version must be the integer 1

findings.title: Undo steps were not validated: a list raised AttributeError and a restore could set a rule's name
findings.fix: _check_step validates shape, ids and field paths, refuses id, name and rank and unknown ATP switches before any read

findings.title: ATP choices were coerced with bool(): the string "false" turned a switch on
findings.fix: atp values must be JSON booleans

findings.title: The same SSL rule picked twice was planned and written twice
findings.fix: moves are de-duplicated by rule id; conflicting targets are refused; ids are short scalars

findings.title: Applying Permissive's ATP turned off a block the tenant had today without a warning
findings.fix: the plan warns for every ATP switch it turns off

findings.title: The ATP PUT was rebuilt from the SDK model, so a setting the model does not know could be reset
findings.fix: read_atp keeps every raw field the model leaves out under its own name

findings.title: Cutting an untrusted title to its byte limit removed one character per pass (quadratic CPU)
findings.fix: _fit_bytes cuts to the limit first, then trims multi-byte characters

findings.title: An unknown tier string was accepted when a framework was given
findings.fix: the tier is one of the four, or 'captured' with a framework

findings.title: A capture over 200 rules per area was cut silently
findings.fix: not_exported names how many rules were left out

findings.title: An AI Guard Undo could delete any object whose name merely contained AIG-, and an Undo update did not check the object's name
findings.fix: only exact builder names (optional prefix, AIG-, known suffix) may be deleted or put back; updates check the name; the settings object cannot be deleted

findings.title: An AI Guard write did not re-check the object's name before updating it (renamed between re-plan and write)
findings.fix: _h_step marks a renamed object as a conflict

findings.title: AI Guard ids were matched with a `$` regex that accepts a trailing newline (it reaches an SDK path)
findings.fix: ids use fullmatch and refuse booleans

findings.title: Stop while reading the AI Guard routing page ended the job as failed (ai_guard.Stopped was not the engine's Stop)
findings.fix: ops_aiguard maps ai_guard.Stopped to admin_ops.Stopped

findings.title: AI Guard readiness said ready when the proxies, gateways or forwarding rules could not be read
findings.fix: unreadable lists are warnings and ready needs every required check present and passing

findings.title: A Gen AI SKU next to a numeric subscription id was not recognised
findings.fix: both id and sku are matched

findings.title: Baseline areas or Undo areas not ticked were refused only after sign-in: the engine's pre-sign-in check does not pass the spec to a plugin
findings.fix: admin_ops.require_scope gives a plugin's in_scope the spec when its signature takes it (inspect.signature), so the baseline refuses unticked areas and Undo steps before sign-in. Also ...::test_the_engine_scope_check_before_sign_in_passes_the_spec_to_the_baseline

findings.title: A detection policy threshold from the tenant such as 1.2.3 crashed the AI Guard plan (ValueError)
findings.fix: _det_sig compares a non-number threshold as none

findings.title: A captured framework could not be loaded again when a tenant rule name had < or > or a value that is not a Zscaler name
findings.fix: capture leaves such a rule out with the reason; capture and load share one field check

findings.title: On a re-run the AI Guard SSL Inspect rule was kept above Do Not Decrypt rules only, not above SSL inspection Block rules
findings.fix: enabled BLOCK rules count as stoppers too

findings.title: Isolate in place of the tier's Block was not flagged as weaker
findings.fix: review flags Block -> Isolate (and Caution)

findings.title: The baseline form's own weaker-than-the-tier chip does not flag Block -> Isolate (static/ops_zia_baseline.js mirrors the review)
findings.fix: add the same Block -> Isolate/Caution check to effective() (patch below)
